answer: Sybil resistance relies on collateral escrowed per identity: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same conflicting attestations, linked evidence makes penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier further increases capital loss, so a swarm risks substantially more than the sum of isolated identities. Even at the nadir of the tide, linked signatures expose the swarm; no vault can restore slashed bonds.
